The Da'wah that Hadhrat Mus'ab bin Umayr (RA) Gave
The Da'wah that Hadhrat Mus'ab bin Umayr (RA) gave to Hadhrat Usayd bin Hudhayr (RA) who Accepts Islaam

blocks.narrator: Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abi Bakr bin Muhammad bin Amr bin Hazm
blocks.text: Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abi Bakr bin Muhammad bin Amr bin Hazm and many others narrate that Hadhrat As'ad bin Zuraarah (RA) took Hadhrat Mus'ab bin Umayr (RA) to the locality of the Banu Abdil Ash'hal and the Banu Zafar tribes. They entered one of the orchards of the Banu Zafar tribe where there was a well called Bir Maraq. The two of them sat in the orchard and many Muslims gathered there with them. During those days, Hadhrat Sa'd bin Mu'aadh (RA) and Hadhrat Usayd bin Hudhayr (RA) were two leaders of the Banu Abdil Ash'hal tribe and were still Mushrikeen steadfast on the religion of their forefathers. Hadhrat Sa'd bin Mu'aadh (RA) also happened to be the cousin of Hadhrat As'ad bin Zuraarah (RA).

When these two leaders heard about the gathering, Hadhrat Sa'd bin Mu'aadh (RA) said to Hadhrat Usayd bin Hudhayr (RA), "Have you no father (no self-respect)?! Go to those two men who have come to our locality to make fools of our gullible people. Admonish and reprimand them for coming to our area. I would have done this for you had it not been for the relation As'ad bin Zuraarah has with me as you know. He is my cousin and I cannot confront him." Hadhrat Usayd (RA) took his spear and went to them. When Hadhrat As'ad (RA) saw him approach, he said to Hadhrat Mus'ab (RA), "He is the leader of his people. He is coming to you so be sincere to Allaah when speaking to him." Hadhrat Mus'ab (RA) said, "I shall speak to him if he is willing to sit down."

Hadhrat Usayd (RA) stood in front of them and began swearing them. He said, "Why have you come to us? Have you come to make fools of our gullible people? You will leave us alone if of you want to preserve your lives!" Hadhrat Mus'ab (RA) said to him, "Will you not be seated and listen awhile. If you like what you hear, you may accept it. Otherwise, we shall stop doing what you dislike." Hadhrat Usayd (RA) said, "That is a fair proposition." He then stuck his spear into the ground and sat down. Hadhrat Mus'ab (RA) then spoke to him about Islaam and recited the Qur'aan to him. Hadhrat Mus'ab (RA) and Hadhrat As'ad (RA) say that from the radiance and gentleness they saw in the face of Hadhrat Usayd (RA), they recognised that he would accept Islaam before he could even mention it.
